ads.headline: £250 a tooth. Nothing filed down.
ads.primary:
Veneers here are £995 a tooth. Bonding is £250.

That's the honest difference, and price isn't the only one.

Veneers mean filing down a healthy tooth. Bonding doesn't. We add tooth-coloured resin to the tooth you already have, shape it by hand and polish it to match. A chipped edge, a small gap, one tooth shorter than the rest: usually done in one visit of 1 to 2 hours.

Most people need two to four teeth, not a full set.

5.0 from 156 Google reviews. Every bonding treatment comes with a 12-month warranty.

Book a free consultation. We'll look, tell you what bonding can and can't do for your teeth, and give you the price before anything starts.

ads.headline: One visit. Still your smile.
ads.primary:
You rarely show your teeth when you smile. Even when you do, it's only the front two.

You didn't decide that. It just happened, one photo at a time.

Usually it's one small thing. An edge that's chipped. A tooth a bit shorter than the others. A gap you notice and nobody else does.

That kind of thing can be fixed in one appointment, without changing the teeth you like.

Bonding is tooth-coloured resin, added to the tooth and shaped by hand, so nothing healthy is drilled away. Most bonding at Siha is finished in a single 1 to 2 hour visit. No temporaries, no second trip.

From £250 a tooth, with a 12-month warranty. 5.0 from 156 Google reviews.

Book a free consultation and see what's possible before you commit to anything.

ads.headline: How long does bonding really last?
ads.primary:
"Composite only lasts a couple of years. It chips easily."

You've probably read that. It's half true, so here's the whole answer.

With normal care, bonding lasts 5 to 7 years. Coffee, tea and red wine can stain it over time. Biting ice, pens or nails can chip it. We tell you all of that at your consultation, not after.

What we do about it: we check your bonding at every visit and polish or touch it up when it needs it. Every bonding treatment comes with a 12-month warranty.

From £250 a tooth. One appointment, 1 to 2 hours.

Book a free consultation and ask us anything. We'd rather you decide with the full picture.

ads.headline: We'd rather add than drill.
ads.primary:
Your teeth are healthy. They're just a bit uneven.

So why does every quote start with filing them down?

Veneers mean removing healthy enamel, for good. For a chipped edge or a small gap, you often don't need that.

Bonding works the other way round. Resin is added to the tooth, shaped and polished, so nothing healthy is taken away.

We usually bond two to four teeth, not ten. Natural for your face, not a row of identical white teeth.

From £250 a tooth. 12-month warranty. 5.0 from 156 Google reviews.

Book a free consultation. We'll tell you honestly whether bonding is right for you, even if the answer is no.

ads.headline: The same teeth. Just better.
ads.primary:
You don't want new teeth. You want yours, whiter and repaired where they need it.

You've seen what happened to your friends' smiles. Too white. Too big. All the same. You'd rather keep hiding yours than end up with that.

You don't have to choose.

Most natural-looking results come from small steps in the right order. Straighten if they need it. Whiten. Then bond only the edges that still need it, adding to the tooth rather than filing it down.

ads.headline: Straighten. Whiten. Then bond.
ads.primary:
Most of the smiles people admire weren't filed down. They were straightened and whitened.

That's the order we work in.

First, straighten if your teeth need it. Our aligner cases are designed by an orthodontist, and a 3D scan shows you the predicted result before you commit.

Then whiten, so any bonding is matched to your new shade, not your old one. Bonding doesn't whiten afterwards, so the order matters.

Then bond, only where an edge or a gap still needs it. Resin is added to the tooth, so nothing healthy is filed away. From £250 a tooth.

It takes longer than a week abroad. It also leaves you with your own teeth.

Book a free consultation and we'll tell you which steps you actually need. Often it's fewer than you think.

ads.file: Natural smile 5 - Tell us the result
ads.headline: Tell us the result. We'll find the route.
ads.primary:
Not sure if you need aligners, whitening, bonding or veneers? You don't need to know.

Most people walk in knowing exactly what they want to see in the mirror and not knowing what it's called. That's normal.

Here's the short version:
Aligners move your teeth. Nothing is removed.
Whitening lifts the shade. Nothing is removed.
Bonding adds resin to the tooth. Nothing is removed.
Veneers cover the front of the tooth. Some enamel is removed, permanently.

At your free consultation, you tell us the result you want. We tell you the route, what each step involves and what it costs, with nothing booked until you're ready.

Bonding from £250 a tooth. 5.0 from 156 Google reviews.

Book a free consultation. Just bring the result you want.

ads.headline: White spots, one appointment.
ads.primary:
One appointment. 60 to 90 minutes. No needles, no drilling.

That's ICON, our treatment for white and brown spots on the teeth.

Most cosmetic fixes mean several visits or removing healthy enamel. ICON works differently. A resin is drawn into the porous, marked enamel, filling it so the spot fades into the tooth around it. Your natural tooth stays intact.

It treats white spots after braces, fluorosis, early marks from decay and some trauma-related discolouration.

From £395 for up to two teeth, £100 for each additional tooth.

ads.headline: Three steps, in the right order.
ads.primary:
A smile makeover doesn't have to mean veneers. Ours usually takes three steps, in this order.

1. Align. Clear aligners move your teeth into place, usually over six to nine months, depending on your case. They're designed by an orthodontist and planned with a 3D scan, so you can see the predicted result before you start.
2. Whiten. Enlighten whitening, 14 nights at home with custom trays, with a VITA B1 shade guarantee.
3. Bond. One appointment to reshape the two to four edges that still need it, matched to your new shade. From £250 a tooth.

Whitening comes before bonding because bonding doesn't whiten afterwards. The order is what makes it look natural.

ads.headline: You probably don't need ten veneers.

Ten veneers here would be £9,950. And they'd mean filing down ten healthy teeth.

That's how we approach most makeovers: align, whiten, then bond the two to four teeth that still need it. Less treatment, less upkeep, and your own teeth underneath.
